anchors.note: The 1219 grid (src/data/by-sa/terrain-1219.json), unchanged. It holds until 1250, the end of its pollen window.
Forest and conifer shares from pollen window 3; 1425 is the middle of the window.
Forest and conifer shares from pollen window 2; 1725 is the middle of the window.
Forest and conifer shares from pollen window 1; 1900 is the middle of the window.

Forest share per 1 degree square from ESA WorldCover 2021 tree cover, over the cells that may be forest. Conifer share from pollen window 1 (AD 1850-1950): WorldCover has no conifer class, and the satellite conifer map tried would show far less conifer in Lithuania than its forest inventory reports (TO CHECK, see data/sources.md).

labels.forestShare: Forest share: estimated from pollen (REVEALS; 1 degree cells; gaps filled by a statistical model) for AD 1250-1600, 1600-1850 and 1850-1950, and from satellite land cover (ESA WorldCover) for 2021
labels.forestEdges: Which places were cleared or grew back, and in which year: placed by a rule (clearings spread out from open land), not a historical map
